title: Competitive landscape & our edge
intro: Most studios cluster into four models. The stable lane for consistent cashflow is Ops-led Boutique: premium experience with standardized systems so you can scale, reduce disputes, and protect margins.

types.title: Budget Rack / High-volume
types.summary: Wins on low price + quantity. Weak on fit consistency, hygiene control, and disputes.
types.risk: Risk: price wars + higher damage rate.

types.title: Typical Boutique
types.summary: Wins on service and taste. Weak on operational throughput and fixed-cost sensitivity.

types.title: Studio Bundle / Photo-first
types.summary: Wins via partner bundles. Weak if partners leave or promo-driven pricing dilutes brand.

types.title: Ops-led Boutique (Us)
types.summary: Wins on reliability: fit-first, hygiene SLA, dispute-proof handover, and weekday productization.

standoutLeft.title: How we stand out (high ROI)
bullets: Calm Bride System: pre-education + reminders + fit checklist.
Quality seal: ready-to-wear checklist + timestamped cleaning.
Soft delivery, strict system: clear policies enforced kindly.

chinaRight.title: Borrow smart from China marketplace
bullets: Package-first selling: fewer choices, clearer tiers, higher conversion.
Capacity pooling: partner tailors/cleaners for fast turnaround.
Content loop: sanitization + fit checks = trust building.
